items.t: Zacks Industry Outlook Highlights Viatris, Teva Pharmaceuticals and Sandoz
items.sum: Viatris, Teva Pharmaceuticals and Sandoz stand out as complex generics, biosimilars and new product launches shape the industry's growth prospects for 2027.

items.t: RBC favours pharma growth stocks on biosimilar, dermatology opportunities
items.sum: Investing.com -- RBC Capital Markets upgraded Sandoz Group AG to "outperform" from "sector perform" on Wednesday, saying a new bottom-up analysis of its pipeline puts its EBITDA forecasts 10% above consensus by 2031. It raised its price target to CHF 96 from CHF 65.

items.t: 3 Generic Drug Stocks to Watch as Drugmakers Seek Growth in 2027
items.sum: The Medical - Generic Drugs industry is poised for growth in 2027 as Viatris, Teva and Sandoz expand complex generics, biosimilars and new product launches.
